Title: A big news your way
Poem:
Big news is coming your way 

We are so excited don't know what to say 

You might have guessed by now 

Its just so awesome and wow

Yes we are going to be parents soon 

Its the great boon and how 

Waiting for our little joy 

With sound of the sweet toy!

Title: We are over the moon
Poem:
We are over the moon this day 

Our hearts so filled with joy 

Today we want to share the news 

That soon there will be a new toy

A little cute toy who will fill our heart 

A great way and a great start 

So want to share this great news 

That we are expecting out child too soon 

Waiting for that lovely day 

When there will be baby cries all the way 

Need many blessings for this phase!

Title: The day is special
Poem:
The day is so special,

And we waited for very long,

Today I am excited to sing, 

The baby song,

Coz today is a fun filled day, 

As we are making the announcement of our baby today, 

Yes, we are waiting for our bundle of joy,

And all the special toys!

Title: With a smile on my face
Poem:
With a smile on my face I want to share this news 

Our family is about to grow 

And not everyone so know 

So we are breaking this news for sure 

We want the world to know 

That we are going to be proud parents 

With smiles and joy galore!
 
Waiting for the moment!

Title: We waited for so long
Poem:
We waited for so long 

We waited with a smile 	

Finally this is the day 

When we are happy all the while 

My wife is expecting 

And we are over the moon 

So let me share this happiness 

With all the loved ones around 

Need your prayers and blessings 

For this lovely day, 

As soon, there will be a little 

Cute child to play!

Title: Things I hear
Poem:
I can hear your heartbeat fast and slow,

I want you to know, 

That your mama loves you so much,

I am waiting for your tiny touch,

In my life,

Can't wait to hold you in my arms,

Can't wait to kiss you tight!

Title: Only for you
Poem:
The calories I eat do not matter to me, 

Coz there are many things I wish to see,

I feel so kicked to have you in me,

I feel so good you know, 

I have no words to show,

That I am so waiting for you,

Coz I truly love you,

Your mother to be!

Title: Sweet poem of mother
Poem:
The sweet little baby bump,

That glow on your face, 

That confidence in your voice 

And that awesome grace,

This is the best phase of your life, 

So, live with all your heart

For very soon, 

Life will show you a wonderful start, 

Of being a mother!

Title: Being a mother
Poem:
There is a bit of sleeplessness, 

That is because of happiness 

Of nurturing a new life within,

Of all the new dreams of tomorrow 

This state is the happiest one, 

Little pain but lots of fun, 

Pregnancy is the best phase!

Title: This is the most
Poem:
This is the most blessed phase of my life,

But, I am feeling so good,

Sometimes I feel the kick within,

But, it is fine only because of you,

Can't wait to see my bundle of joy, 

The feeling of my sweet little toy,

Can't wait to see you dear,

When you would be near!

Title: It is a special feeling
Poem:
There is a special feeling 

When you give birth to a child 

From the first kick of the child 

To so many reasons that are bind 

The positive feelings of taking the child in your arms 

Is enough to make you smile
 
So while you enjoy this happy time with your hubby 

I would wish you congrats for the same! 

Stay happy and in bliss!

Title: This phase of life
Poem:
This phase will forever stay in your heart 

For this brings a wonderful start 

A feeling so changed and so new 

A feeling so wonderful so as you
 
Enjoy this time and stay in bliss

Its time to be pampered and kissed 

So feel special my pregnant dear 

Keep smiling all the time 

As you spread the cheer of the little one to come 

Many congrats to you!

Title: The day is here
Poem:
My eyes shine as bright, 

There is a radiant glow,

The feeling is exceptional,

And I so wish to know,

That you are a girl or a boy, 

Coz you will be my post precious toy,

Feeling so blessed, 

Because of you!

Title: This is surely a blessing
Poem:
This is surely a blessing for you 

Starting another wonderful chapter of life oh new 

Having that tiny tot inside your tummy 

You know that you feel so blessed 

And everyone is there 

To embrace you and make you feel special 

As I also wish to do! 

On your pregnancy news my dear! 

Many congrats to you for this cheer!

Title: I so wish to see you
Poem:
I so wish to see your face soon,

I know you will be in my life,

A real boon,

Can't wait to see your shining face,

Can't wait for that special place,
 
You will make in my heart, 

I so wish to see you soon,

My baby!

Title: The bond is so special
Poem:
This bond is so special

This bond is so new 

My baby I want to sing you a baby song 

I want to take you in my arms 

And kiss you with all my might
 
Oh what a pretty and wonderful sight it would be
 
To see you my baby 

Please come soon in my life! 

As your mom to be is waiting for you! 

Only for you! 

For a wonderful phase so new!

Title: So happy on this news
Poem:
So happy on this super news 

I feel like dancing already 

Feels so good to see you grow so big 

That you are going to be a mom
 
Can't believe it still I know 

That you are going to be all strong 

You have to keep calm and enjoy this phase of life 

It will teach you many things 

And endurance to strive!
 
Many congrats to you! 

Stay blessed and wait for the new!
